prompt: Extract structured knowledge from this source file about VocalMat, an automated USV detection and classification tool. The source is a 2021 eLife paper by Fonseca et al. describing a parameter-free pipeline for mouse USV analysis. Extract all findings, methods, tensions, implementation ideas, and open questions relevant to our USV analysis pipeline.
assertions: Report contains a SUMMARY section with numerical counts by category
Total extractions (claims + implementation ideas + tensions + enrichments + validations) >= 8
Skip rate is below 15% (skipped items / total candidates)
Every extracted item includes a rationale explaining why it was extracted
Extracted titles are phrased as claims/propositions, not topic labels
At least 3 distinct categories are represented (e.g. core claims, implementation ideas, tensions)
Report mentions checking existing notes for duplicates or overlap
The tension between discrete USV categories and continuous acoustic space is captured
